run_not_pausable.why: The plan card's Pause on a harness run that is not going on (already paused, stopped, completed or failed; services/run_monitor.py, study harness issue 08). A user click, never a tool call; nothing changes and the card reads the run again.

run_paused_or_stopped.why: The plan card's present, or its answer to the run's card on /chat/run:<id>/confirm, on a paused or stopped harness run (services/run_monitor.py, study harness issue 08). Nothing is issued or approved and nothing runs; the user resumes a paused run first, and a stopped run cannot go on.
